thread:
IncidentBot: ALERT: Elevated KV cache churn and continuous-batch backpressure on shardpool-eu-west-1. Severity: P1 :rotating_light:
Leah (oncall): on pager, looking at metrics now. Noted error spike on Llama-70B-mQA and degraded p95 latency to ~9s.
Diego (eng-sre): Kept an eye on insertion_rate and unique_key_cardinality — both jumped 12x at T-4m. This looks like a card explosion rather than node leak. Nodes reporting eviction storms.
Priya (eng-runtime): Runtime traces show the continuous_batcher is grouping very large batches because per-request token_count heuristics are underestimating due to tokenizers returning multi-byte tokens for certain languages. That caused oversized prefix sets and KV backing store thrash.
Omar (eng-ml): model-specific note: Llama-70B with MQA settings creates more distinct cache keys per conversation branch; Mistral/GQA have much lower branching here. Qwen manifests intermittent bursts.
Nina (support): Globex reported 503s and 15s tail latencies for some calls; they're on Dedicated EU pool. They opened a severity ticket: https://globex.example/ticket/4432.
Ben (product): customer impact assessment needed — which customers on eu-west-1 saw errors and which model families?
Leah (oncall): immediate mitigations: 1) set continuous_batch.max_batch_tokens to 800 2) enable kv_cache.sample_eviction for high-card models 3) temporarily route Llama-70B-mQA traffic to a lower-concurrency pool. Implementing now.
Priya (eng-runtime): hotpatch config prepared:
```yaml
continuous_batch:
  max_batch_tokens: 800
  max_inflight_requests: 48
kv_cache:
  sample_eviction: true
  eviction_window_ms: 500
  eviction_threshold_mb: 1600
routing:
  per_model_overrides:
    Llama-70B-mQA:
      target_pool: eu-west-lowcon
      allow_fallback: true
```
Priya (eng-runtime): applying hotpatch to two canary nodes (gpu-42, gpu-43). Starting drain and restart.
IncidentBot: deploy-started by Leah (oncall) 1: canary nodes gpu-42,gpu-43.
Diego (eng-sre): logs show insert_rate drop ~78% on canary, TTL evictions increased (expected). Memory usage down from 95% to 45% after patch.
Omar (eng-ml): note: routing Llama-70B-mQA to lower concurrency pool reduces combinatorial prefix mixing — it's a short-term mitigation until we fix tokenizer-induced expansion. We should add tokenizer diagnostics to the model onboarding flow.
Nina (support): Globex confirms some sessions improved when routed; still seeing a fraction of requests failing that hit non-canary nodes. ETA for full roll: ~25m. They've asked for a status bulletin.
Ben (product): draft outbound: "We're mitigating a KV-cache and batching regression affecting some Llama MQA traffic in eu-west-1. Hotfix applied to canaries; full rollout in progress. Expected full mitigation within 30 minutes. We're investigating root cause and will share a postmortem." Approve?
Leah (oncall): approve. Rolling to rest of pool in 3m waves.
Priya (eng-runtime): rolling with 2-node parallelism, 20s drain. Monitoring traces for kv.insert_rate, batch_size_histogram, and p95 latency.
Diego (eng-sre): watching alerts: error rate trending down across pool. Rolling complete at +18m.
Omar (eng-ml): early hypothesis: certain Unicode sequences from Globex traffic trigger tokenizer splits that increase token count per semantic unit, creating more unique prefixes in MQA. We'll add regression tests for emoji and multilingual inputs.
Nina (support): Globex updated: they will run a test harness of typical calls and share traces. They asked for compensation? Escalation to Accounts if needed.
Ben (product): recommend a courtesy message to affected customers with timeline and mitigation. Flag accounts with high error exposure for review.
Leah (oncall): handoff: Diego will take 1hr monitoring and own the postmortem. My notes: root cause tied to continuous-batching heuristics + tokenizer-cardinality interacting badly with Llama MQA. Hotfix: lowered batch caps, enabled sampling eviction, routing override. Customer-facing window ~25m.
Diego (eng-sre): taking over. I'll keep bridge open and start postmortem doc. Initial action items:
- eng-runtime: add per-model tokenizer-cardinality guard and reject batch growth beyond X * median for pool.
- eng-ml: add tokenizer fuzz tests and model-specific kv-key distribution checks.
- support: prepare client timeline & outreach for Globex/others in eu-west-1.
- infra: alert on unique_key_cardinality per-model > threshold.
Leah (oncall): closing shift, leave monitoring to Diego. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
Globex_CustEng: thanks, latency looks better on our tests. Please include recommended client-side retries/backoff in postmortem.
Diego (eng-sre): confirmed stable at +40m, p95 back to normal. Downgrading severity to P2. Saving logs and traces to incident channel. Drafting postmortem and will attach next steps.
Priya (eng-runtime): opening PR for runtime guardrails + a unit test that simulates tokenizer-induced token explosion.
Omar (eng-ml): adding MQA/GQA split tests to nightly to detect similar regressions.
Nina (support): updated Globex ticket and CC'd accounts team.
Ben (product): good work. We'll follow up in postmortem with communication plan.
IncidentBot: incident marked as resolved by Diego (eng-sre).
